_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_minor" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "archived_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "relationship" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "transferred_at" TEXT NULL, "transferred_to_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_period_start" TEXT NULL, "typical_cycle_length_days" INTEGER NULL, "typical_period_length_days" INTEGER NULL, "tracking_preferences" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "day_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "flow" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "note" TEXT NULL, "pms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pms" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "logged_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_modified_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_id" TEXT NULL, "import_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_guardians" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'accepted', "display_name" TEXT NULL, "invited_by" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "observations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES day_entries (id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "value_num" REAL NULL, "value_text" TEXT NULL, "unit" TEXT NULL, "intensity" INTEGER NULL, "excluded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("excluded" IN (0, 1)), "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "source_id" TEXT NULL, "import_id" TEXT NULL, "raw" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "logged_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_modified_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_modes" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tracking', "mode_started_on" TEXT NULL, "birth_control_method" TEXT NULL, "birth_control_started_on" TEXT NULL, "birth_control_stopped_on" TEXT NULL, "health_sync_consent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("health_sync_consent" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cycle_overrides" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "cycle_start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "excluded_from_average" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("excluded_from_average" IN (0, 1)), "manual_start" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("manual_start" IN (0, 1)), "note_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "logged_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_modified_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visit_prep_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_checked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_checked" IN (0, 1)), "checked_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "checked_at" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "dirty" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dirty" IN (0, 1)), "local_rev" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "logged_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_modified_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 1), "bound_user_id" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cursor_profiles" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_day_entries" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_observations" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_profile_modes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_cycle_overrides" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_care_notes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cursor_visit_prep_items" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_full_pull_at" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "server_clock_offset_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
